scope.source_scope: Discord corpus only; no outside knowledge used
scope.timezone_for_trade_date: America/Chicago (UTC-05 in July); explicit 10AM labels are preserved as New York market-time concepts from message text

methodology.unit_of_analysis: Single executed trade when separable; otherwise labeled aggregate session, missed/skipped setup, or paper trade.
methodology.outcome_policy: Only win/loss/breakeven/mixed/cancelled/open/unknown. Explicit stops, signed P&L or R, result words, and no-trade language control. Hypothetical later movement and favorable adjectives do not change the executed outcome.
methodology.linkage_policy: Same-message attribution preferred. Short same-author sequences used only when strongly linkable. Ordered aggregate mapping is labeled. Unresolvable multi-trade summaries are excluded from rates.
methodology.comparison_policy: Confluence tables use actual-or-unspecified executed records with win/loss and attributable setup detail. Paper, cancelled, unknown, breakeven, mixed, and unresolved aggregate records get zero weight.
methodology.causal_warning: Observed win shares are descriptive of this small self-reported journal corpus, not causal estimates or a strategy backtest.

limitations: Trade screenshots were not independently interpreted; many exact instrument, entry, stop, and target fields remain unknown.
Journals are self-reported and selectively posted; outcomes and paper/missed trades can have different reporting rates.
Requested search starts 2026-07-06, but primary messages begin 2026-07-07T05:32:50.888Z and collection ended midday July 20.
Edited posts and multi-trade summaries are labeled aggregate or strong-sequence rather than exact per-trade ground truth.
A July 20 thespedshed +2R summary conflicts with three explicit -1R posts and no captured offset; no missing winner is invented.
Actual instrument is unknown for most records. NQ/ES SMT comparators are stored separately from the executed-instrument field.

episode_summary.exclusion_reasons: breakeven/mixed/cancelled/open/unknown, paper execution, unresolved aggregate, or absent attributable setup detail

rejection_block_comparison.interpretation_guardrail: RB presence is correlated with which authors documented detailed setups; inspect author concentration before interpreting shares.

instrument_outcome_comparison.nq_vs_es_caveat: Only executed instrument is counted. NQ/ES SMT comparator mentions are excluded, leaving too few explicit ES and MNQ/NQ executions for a credible product comparison.
